meta.name: gget
meta.description: Fast CLI/Python queries to 20+ bioinformatics databases. Use for quick lookups: gene info, BLAST/BLAT, viral sequence downloads, AlphaFold structures, enrichment analysis, OpenTargets, COSMIC, CELLxGENE, and 8cube mouse specificity/expression data. Best for interactive exploration and simple queries. For batch processing or advanced BLAST use biopython; for multi-database Python workflows use bioservices.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 获取基因、序列与蛋白结构等生物数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常需要快速查询基因、序列和结构等生物数据
copy.tagline_en: Query gene, sequence, and structure data from 20+ bio databases.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need quick lookups of gene, sequence, and protein structure data in bio research.

howto.what: Claude 会通过 gget 的命令行或 Python 接口查询 20+ 生物信息数据库，产出基因信息、序列、蛋白结构、表达与疾病关联等结果，命令行默认返回 JSON/CSV，Python 返回 DataFrame 或字典。
howto.when: 当你要求做基因/转录本查询、BLAST/BLAT 比对、AlphaFold 结构预测等单次快速查询时触发；原文说明批量处理或多数据库 Python 流程应改用 biopython 或 bioservices。

say.text: 用 gget 查一下 ENSG00000034713 的基因信息
say.note: 命令行返回 JSON，Python 返回 DataFrame

say.text: 用 gget blast 比对这段蛋白序列，只留前 10 条命中
say.note: 可指定 -db 数据库与 -l 上限

say.text: gget archs4 -w tissue ACE2 查一下组织表达
say.note: 返回各组织的表达量数值

howto.what_en: Claude uses gget's CLI or Python API to query 20+ bioinformatics databases, producing gene info, sequences, protein structures, expression and disease data as JSON/CSV or DataFrames.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for a single quick lookup like gene info, BLAST/BLAT or an AlphaFold structure; the source says batch jobs or multi-database Python workflows should use biopython or bioservices instead.

say_en.text: Use gget to fetch info for ENSG00000034713
say_en.note: Returns JSON, or a DataFrame in Python

say_en.text: Run gget blast on this protein sequence, keep 10 hits
gget archs4 -w tissue ACE2 for tissue expression
